name: game
description: A free browser tank arcade in the spirit of the 2010 classic. No registration, no pay-to-win: 7 hulls, 9 turrets, 101 paints, 91 maps.

paragraphs: A browser tank arcade that brings back the classic 2010 tank game: the angular hulls — Wasp, Hunter, Titan, Dictator — the boxy maps of hangars, garages and sand arenas, and the feel of a heavy machine on suspension that rocks over bumps, flies off ramps and shoves with its sides. Open the page and you are in a battle a few seconds later.

No registration. No donations. Everything unlocked from the first second. Pick a call sign, a tank and a map — and play. Alone against bots, or with friends in a password-protected room, or with strangers from the open rooms list.

This repository is the mobile edition: a PWA built for phones (touch controls, install to the home screen, gamepad support) that also runs on a desktop browser, plus two interchangeable backends for the lobby and the WebRTC signalling.
features: Modes: Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag (bring the enemy flag home), Assault (carry your own flag to the enemy base), and Explore — drive around any map with no fight and no score.

7 hulls, from the fast glass-cannon Wasp to the slow fortress Mammoth. 9 turrets, each a different way to land damage: instant Smoky, bouncing Ricochet, piercing Railgun, rapid Twins, splash Thunder, the Firebird and…
Supplies for everyone, free and unlimited: repair kit, double armour, double damage, nitro, nuclear energy. The only limit is the cooldown, the same for all. No shop.
50+ classic maps, summer and winter variants, every one open from the start.
Balance tuned for skill: damage spread and falloff, weakened double damage (a Railgun does not one-shot a medium hull even boosted), spawn protection, free spawn points.

requirements.text: For the self-hosted path build the shell with npm run build:mobile, run packages/backend under its supervisor (npm run start -w skilltanki-backend, one process per port) and put config/nginx.conf in front of it.
